nodes.label: You won't get away from me!

You need at least 1,000 chips to play standard
baccarat. Predict whether the player or banker
will win, or whether there will be a tie.

Take part in battles at an underground coliseum
and defeat a series of opponents to win.

side. But don't get too rough with me. Er, I'm getting
ahead of myself, aren't I? What a weird question.
